sources.title: Fiji Government, Public Holidays: Public Holiday Calendar (2026)
sources.said: 1. New Year's Day Thursday, 01 January 2026; 2. Good Friday Friday, 03 April 2026; 3. Easter Saturday Saturday, 04 April 2026; 4. Easter Monday Monday, 06 April 2026; 5. Girmit Day Friday, 15 May 2026; 6. Ratu Sir Lala Sukuna Day Friday, 29 May 2026; 7. Prophet Mohammed's Birthday Monday, 24 August 2026; 8. Fiji Day Saturday, 10 October 2026; 9. Diwali Monday, 9 November 2026; 10. Christmas Day Friday, 25 December 2026; 11. Boxing Day Monday, 28 December 2026.

sources.title: The Fiji Times, Cabinet confirms eleven 2026 public holidays (3 September 2025)
sources.said: Cabinet has endorsed the official public holiday dates for 2026 ... and will be formally declared by the Minister for Employment, Productivity and Workplace Relations through a Gazette Notice. New Year’s Day – Thursday, 1 January; Good Friday – Friday, 3 April; Easter Saturday – Saturday, 4 April; Easter Monday – Monday, 6 April; Girmit Day – Friday, 15 May; Ratu Sir Lala Sukuna Day – Friday, 29 May; Prophet Mohammed’s Birthday – Monday, 24 August; Fiji Day – Saturday, 10 October; Diwali – Monday, 9 November; Christmas Day – Friday, 25 December; Boxing Day – Monday, 28 December.
